title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be the Same Godly Man in the Pew and Alone at Midnight
caption:
You've got a church voice, a group chat voice, and a scrolling-alone-at-midnight voice. Most guys never clock that there are three.

The gap between them is exactly the size of what you're still hiding. Privacy isn't the problem. A second set of standards is. If what you're doing alone couldn't survive a brother walking in, that's the tell.

A godly man in the pew is the same man alone at midnight. Not because he's performing consistency, but because he's stopped needing an audience to do the right thing.

"Search me, O God, and know my heart... see if there is any grievous way in me." (Psalm 139:23-24)

One man, every room. That's the whole aim.
